evidence.reason: The dependency scan enumerates systemd dependency directives in DEPENDENCY_RE, but omits `StopPropagatedFrom=` and `PropagatesStopTo=`. A unit declaring `StopPropagatedFrom=crq-tick.service` (or a unit `PropagatesStopTo=` another managed unit) would not be discovered as dependent, so fence-driven stop propagation can affect a co-tenant. This is an implementation omission in the existing dependency scan, not a new requirement; systemd v257 supports both directives.
